findings.label: Manual-confirm UTR scope
findings.detail: POST /admin/orders/status validates/writes payment_reference for any target status, not only confirmed states as the plan worded it. Harmless (still 12-digit-validated, clears on empty, untouched when absent); no action required unless the owner wants it gated to confirmed states.

findings.label: Abandoned-pending growth
findings.detail: Every Proceed writes a 'Pending Payment' row and most will never be paid; by design there is no TTL cleanup, only the admin pending filter. Monitor table growth; a future TTL job marking stale pendings 'Cancelled' is the documented follow-up.
